caption: The video showcases a field of small pink, magenta and violet particles drifting continuously downward against a dark violet-to-black backdrop. A soft, brighter purple glow remains fixed in the upper-center, accompanied by faint vertical light streaks in the background. The particles appear as out-of-focus dots and short vertical smears, scattered across the whole view with a denser, brighter cluster near the central glow. Over time, individual particles sink lower through the view while the field as a whole keeps a roughly constant density. Some dots brighten to near-white cores and then dim again, producing a twinkling effect rather than a uniform change. Slight lateral wobble accompanies the descent, but the dominant motion is vertical, with no particle landing or stopping in view.
